entities.summary: Pradip Krishen is an Indian filmmaker, naturalist and environmentalist. He directed three films, Massey Sahib in 1985, In Which Annie Gives It Those Ones in 1989 and Electric Moon for Channel 4, UK in 1991. His films have won significant Indian and international awards. In Which Annie Gives It Those Ones acquired cult status in the years after it was made.
